findings.why_it_matters: The rotated row-group labels of Table 11 were OCR'd with their words in reversed and scrambled order ("andsymbols Zero-suppression"). Every x cell of the 24-column by 24-row matrix was checked against the printed table and matches; only the group labels are garbled, and the column header row carries the same group names correctly, so no precedence rule is lost.
